title: One-thread vertical slice first
proposal: Before 05a/05b/06, hand-author one thread (e.g. Sorrel/Pell) end to end: 3 rooms, 3-8 people, one office pretext, Space-driven choices, a visible delayed consequence and an end card with the ledger diff. Play with friends, then generalize.

title: Advisors are the feedback channel and the ethics
proposal: The Ship Mind gives a delayed per-watch statistical debrief; the Drone reports the bodily/room truth; their disagreement is the readout of success/notice/backfire, and major choices show both the expected-lives and the named-person cost.

title: Lace log as notebook / evidence board
proposal: The Ship Mind auto-records overview states, conversation chunks and briefings; the player can diff them; omitted clauses appear as gaps; optionally a diegetic string board in Chambers shows which acts were noticed and by whom.

title: Content-first, extract abstractions later
proposal: Quarantine registry kinds/effects with no content behind a draft area; author Epoch 1 as plain typed data; promote to the epoch-agnostic registry only when a second use exists. Keep lineageId as the forward hook.

title: Text-only advisor/writing prototype
proposal: Before engine work on dialogue/NLP, test the writing and the advisory-duel idea as a plain text page: two conflicting briefings on a hand-authored scenario, the player picks.

title: Seasonal council macro loop; rooms as scenes
proposal: Make the watch clock the primary loop: each season a few verb slots (court, write, study, travel) with advisor advice; rooms are entered when a storylet or office case needs embodiment rather than as free roam (King of Dragon Pass style).

title: Quality-based storylet decks
proposal: Replace slot-grammar storylets with authored cards gated by qualities (stocks, regard, discovery layer, office); slots only for names/places (Sunless Sea / StoryNexus).

title: Epoch as cartridge
proposal: Each epoch is a complete game with its own ending screen; Epoch 1 is a standalone 3-5 hour scenario; later epochs import the ledger like a sequel.

title: CK3-style scheme odds
proposal: Show success %, secrecy and a breakdown of Regard modifiers on every scheme, pretext spend and letter.
